accepted.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game inventory UI icon for Dota 2 custom game 苟发育, matching an approved premium painterly teal/jade/ivory/champagne-gold icon family. Subject: One original cute chibi creature inspired by Chinese Shanhaijing mythology: a fluffy cloud-white winged lion cub. It carries or embraces the distinct magic artifact named 云界旗; the artifact must be recognizable and part of the compact silhouette. Creature is the main subject, miniature expressive two-head-tall proportions. This is original decorative art, no lettering.
Art direction: refined hand-painted collectible sculpture, confident readable large shapes, restrained intricate accents, rich but moderate saturation, soft upper-left highlights, clean silhouette at 64 pixels. Preserve character's own signature colors rather than tinting all subjects blue. Composition: exactly one centered isolated subject, square 512×512 canvas, subject fits entirely within central 82% of canvas with generous transparent margin and no clipping. Background MUST be genuinely transparent with real alpha, not white, black or checkerboard. No panel, no rectangular background, no card, no decorative frame, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no floor, no drop shadow outside the subject.
Critical composition correction for production: the banner is compact and SHORT, its pole and golden pointed finial are lower than the creature's highest ear. Shrink the whole creature-plus-banner to occupy only the central 75% of the square. There must be at least 100 source pixels of fully transparent padding above the highest object, below the feet and on both sides. Deliver a true transparent PNG alpha asset, no visible checkerboard.
